title.narrative: Road Network Upgrading Sector Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will (i) upgrade and climate-proof about 117 kilometers (km) of principal national roads, (ii) expand the road maintenance program of the Ministry of Public Works (MPW), and (iii) prepare detailed designs and environmental and social due diligence for upgrading 169 km of principal national roads through future projects. The project is in line with the ongoing efforts of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and other development partners to support the progressive upgrading of the entire national road network.

title.narrative: 07 Mar 2016 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/timor-leste-gets-extra-762-million-road-upgrade-project
20 Jun 2016 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/tibar-gleno-section-adb-assisted-road-project-now-open
27 Jan 2015 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/timor-leste-adb-mark-start-work-manatuto-natarbora-road
Grant 0404: 75% of contracts awarded and 75% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
Loan 3020: 96% of contracts awarded and 97% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
Loan 3021: 87% of contracts awarded and 96% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
Loan 3341: 57% of contracts awarded and 60% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
Loan 3342: 88% of contracts awarded and 85% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: TIM Government requested extension of L3341/3342 closing date from 30 June 2021 to 31 December 2024.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46260/46260-002-apfs-en_9.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Mar 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46260/46260-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Proactive Integrity Reviews (PIR) | Dec 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45094/45094-001-pprr-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46260/46260-002-rp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46260/46260-002-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Performance-based maintenance (PBM) period for Manatuto-Laclubar Junction (35.13km) started in January 2020 and ended in December 2020. PBM for Laclubar Junction-Natarbora started in December 2020.
In 2020, TIM Government has requested extension of Loan 3020/3021 completion until 30 June 2022 to accommodate DNP and PBM for Laclubar Junction to Natarbora section (i.e., DNP from December 2019 to November 2020; and PBM from December 2020 to November 2021).
The project intended to support the creation of a National Road Safety Council and the formulation of National Road Safety Action Plan. The focal point was envisaged to be the National Directorate of Road Security under the Ministry of Interior , together with the National Police of Timor-Leste. For initial support, a Road Safety Specialist was recruited by PMU to assist in the development of policies and strategies for road safety through the conduct of workshop with key stakeholders to identify capacity, willingness and roles of key stakeholders. For the part of the Ministry, an earlier discussion with PNTL was initially held sometime in March 2018 to coordinate the conduct of road safety awareness program and campaign in one completed loan funded project of the government, with the aim of replicating the approach with the other projects nearing completion particularly RNUSP. However, because of changes in government, as a result of the last election, the road safety awareness campaign was not finalized.
To be assessed.
On HIV awareness seminar involving the workers, their families and the communities, four (4) sessions were already conducted by the Contractor of Package 1 (Manatuto-Laclubar Junction) between April 2016 and November 2018 involving a total of 309 participants, while another two (2) were conducted by the Contractor of Package 2 (Laclubar Junction-Natarbora between September 2017 and March 2018 involving 44 participants, as of Q1 2018. Disaggregated data will be requested from PMU.
For L3341/3342:
-100% of Baucau-Lautem, and Maubara-Karimbala-Mota Ain road section workers have received HIV/AIDS awareness education based on October 2020 report.
-Figures for roadside inhabitants to be requested from PMU.
An earlier discussion with National Police of Timor-Leste was initially held sometime in March 2018 to coordinate the conduct of road safety awareness program and campaign in one completed loan funded project of the government, with the aim of replicating the approach with the other projects nearing completion particularly RNUSP. However, because of changes in government, as a result of the last election, the road safety awareness campaign was not finalized.
Civil works for 35.13km Manatuto-Laclubar Junction and 44.6km Laclubar Junction-Natarbora under Loans 3020/3021, and Grant 0404 have been completed in 2018 and 2019, respectively.
Under Loans 3341/3342, civil works for 58.94km Baucau-Lautem is 98.68% completed equivalent to 56.65km while civil works for 37.8km Maubara-Karimbala + Atabae Mota Ain is 99.40% completed (37.05km). The total completed roads is 95.74m, equivalent to 98.96% of total 96.74km (as of 25 May 2022, based on latest updated provided by MPW/PMU received in July 2022).
Loans 3341/3342 closing date has been revised from 30 June 2021 to 31 December 2024 to allow sufficient time to complete the civil works, including defects liability period, and maintenance. The revised civil works schedule expects completion of Maubara-Karimbala-Mota Ain road section by November 2021 and December 2021 for Baucau to Lautem road section.
Local workers are hired by contactors based on the location of the road sections. Exact number of local workers hired and % of women have yet to be determined/assessed.
Completed in October 2015
Additional scope based on approved memo dated 30 June 2022
